tdm.text: Qatros Karst, where the Fenzala Kin-Tree is kept, is the scene of Mehtma's struggle during a Sultai siege, as she leads her seven charges into the Kin-Tree chamber to be accepted into House Fenzala as adults.
Jurjis requisitions her cows, and a Sultai artillery barrage kills the clerks and wrecks the old marketplace, before Mehtma chases Cemil to the east gate and learns he made a deal with Jurjis.

Mehtma realizes the cow ruse was a distraction so Cemil's passphrase could get House Agach into the chamber, and she finds Jurjis kneeling over the body of young Enti, threatening to chop down the Kin-Tree.

Enti's ancestor-spirit steps out of the Kin-Tree in golden armor and lends Mehtma strength, she kills Jurjis, and a single bud opens into a sun-bright flower as she bargains to become captain of logistics.
